# Devansh Khanna
> Business Solutions Architect | MBA in Data Analytics & Operations
> "Turning Business Problems into Executable Prototypes"

## About Me
I bridge the gap between business strategy and technical execution. With ₹5Cr+ in managed revenue and experience in automotive manufacturing operations, I build rapid AI-powered prototypes that solve real business problems without waiting for perfect software.

## Signature Projects
- **[Neura-Q](https://neuraq.netlify.app/)**: AI-powered strategic decision framework using Graph-of-Thought reasoning to reduce planning cycles from weeks to days.
- **[AI Resume Enhancer](https://resume-ai-dev.netlify.app/)**: Student resume optimization platform with ML-driven placement prediction (85% accuracy) and weakness analysis.
- **[Crypto Market Intelligence](https://btc-arbitrage-analyst.bolt.host/)**: Real-time arbitrage scanner for 2 Indian exchanges with automated profitability calculation pipeline via VectorShift.
- **[QSR Brand Intelligence](https://colab.research.google.com/drive/1tvOLnaMfJI8w-UVfwO6NWKvkH9vgj98B?usp=sharing)**: Social media analytics engine tracking 650+ posts across Domino's, KFC, and McDonald's to identify engagement drivers.
